faq.headline: Hotel Website FAQs
faq.description: Clear answers to help you plan and publish your hotel site.

items.question: Can guests book a room and pay on this site?
items.answer: The website can link to your existing booking engine or collect a request. Live room inventory, confirmation, and payment require a separate supported booking flow.

items.question: Can I show multiple room types?
items.answer: Yes. Present rooms with photos, capacity, amenities, and any rates you can maintain accurately.

items.question: Can I collect preferred dates?
items.answer: A form can collect dates and guest count as an enquiry; your team must confirm availability before a reservation exists.

items.question: What room details can I publish?
items.answer: Show room types, capacity, amenities, accessible features, photos, and rates only when you can keep those details accurate.

items.question: Can guests see live room availability?
items.answer: Not in this website example. You can link to an existing booking engine or collect preferred dates as an enquiry; your team or booking provider confirms availability.

items.question: Can I explain check-in, parking, and cancellation rules?
items.answer: Yes. Add current arrival and departure times, parking information, accessibility details, and the policies guests should review before booking.
